title: cephalaria corniculata
intro: Cephalaria corniculata, commonly known as goat's beard, is a flowering plant that belongs to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria corniculata involve its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit antitumor activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
